surface.name: JRC Global Surface Water v1.4 (EC JRC / Google), 1984-2021
surface.caveat: Zero means no water seen by Landsat at 30 m, not no water. Distance is to inland permanent water (sea excluded). Coastal desa polygons include sea pixels.

rain.name: CHIRPS v2.0 monthly (Climate Hazards Center, UC Santa Barbara)
rain.caveat: Spatial check FAILED: normal rainfall and dry months are an island-scale picture, not a desa ranking. Only the timing of wet and dry months/years was checked (NASA POWER, ~50 km cells, median r 0.76); trend, recent-vs-normal and driest year were not checked against it. Desa flagged sharedCell take one ~5.5 km cell's value.

stress.name: WRI Aqueduct 4.0 water risk atlas (baseline annual, baseline monthly, future annual)
stress.caveat: Only 2 Aqueduct sub-basins cover Bali: every mainland desa has the same values (Nusa Penida/Lembongan/Ceningan the other). Island-level context, not a ranking. Projections shown: business-as-usual (SSP3 RCP7.0).

buildings.name: Overture Maps Foundation, buildings theme (type=building), release 2026-10-21.0
buildings.caveat: Share of the village under building footprints. Ranks villages like the Sentinel-2 built-up share (Spearman 0.98, n = 225) but runs lower, because roads and yards are not footprints.
